title.zh: 依第 411 条出具的紧急证明

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 7

CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM CERTIFICATE OF URGENCY UNDER ARTICLE 41(1) In exercise of the power conferred by Article 41(1) of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby certifies that there is a case of urgency in respect of the Supply (2025/2026) Bill, 2025. Dated this 21st. day of Sya'aban, 1446 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of February, 2025 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalan1.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM. Dicetak oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
